name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Moldova defend itself against Russian interference before its presidential election and a referendum on joining the EU on 20 October 2024. It asks for more EU money and support to fight disinformation and cyberattacks, new sanctions on people who undermine Moldova, and faster work on Moldova's EU membership. It also urges Russia to stop its meddling and withdraw its troops from Moldova. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to act: more sanctions, support and faster membership talks.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova's government and voters, the EU, and Russia.
- **What happens next:** The EU Council and Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
